run_doctest_properties: run the doctest suite for Boost.Python property bindings on the properties extension module
test_readonly_property: test that a read-only property on class X raises AttributeError when assignment is attempted
test_readwrite_property: test that a read-write property on class X can be set and retrieved with the correct value
test_instance_count: test the class-level instance_count property tracks live instances of X across creation and deletion
test_property_docstrings: test that property descriptors expose correct docstrings for fget and fset methods
